notes:
Quick, focused account: mid-market SaaS that builds in-product discovery and support search. Primary ask: embeddings-first evaluation to replace current hybrid BM25 + embeddings layer. Wants low-friction Hosted API POC (two-week) then move to Dedicated for predictable peak handling.
- Workloads: nightly batch ingestion of ~200k documents/month + realtime query traffic (spikes to 300 qps during launches).
- Targets: search p95 < 120ms for semantic rerank; embedding throughput for bulk jobs ~10k vectors/hour (can batch).
- Vector DB: prefers Pinecone but open to Redis Vector or Milvus if cost wins. Wants connectors/examples for Pinecone + Postgres metadata sync.
- Security: SOC2 mandatory, SSO via SAML, audit logs required, KMS for keys. EU customer subset requires data residency option for search indexes.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market budget; wants clear tradeoffs (batching/quantization) to hit ARR goals. Asking: 'what's the lift for Dedicated and how fast can we failover to hosted if capacity spikes?'
- SE notes: prototype ingestion script uses 64-item embedding batches, memory usage spikes on larger models; recommended: start with hosted gpt-like embedding then test quantized dedicated model for cost.
- Sales notes: prepare 3 pricing scenarios (hosted POC only; POC -> Dedicated reserved; Dedicated + Optimize bundle).
technical_requirements: Embedding throughput >= 10k vectors/hour for bulk jobs
Search latency p95 < 120ms for user-facing rerank
Connector examples for Pinecone and Redis Vector
Option to redact PII before vectorization
use_case_summary: Replace current product+help search stack with embedding-backed semantic search. POC scope: ingest 6k sample records, measure embedding cost/time and end-to-end query latency against existing BM25 baseline. Follow-on: Dedicated for guaranteed throughput during new product launches and support spikes.
reason_for_evaluation: Need predictable latency and unit-cost control. Current vendor lock on managed vector DB + API costs rising; team wants ability to move to reserved capacity while retaining simple API for engineering velocity.
deal_notes: AE to present Dedicated sizing options after POC metrics are in. Finance needs ARR estimate for procurement. Legal needs DPA updates; infra needs VPC CIDR details. Expected internal procurement cycle ~8-10 weeks after POC.
competitive_landscape_notes: Customer currently piloting Pinecone (hosted) and evaluating self-hosted Milvus. Concerned about lock-in and costs. Redwood positioning: faster time-to-value on Hosted API + clear path to Dedicated with routing and fallback guarantees.
